question: Who among the following is one of the awardees of Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021 in the discipline of wrestling?
solution:
The correct answer is __Ravi Kumar __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ravi Kumar Dahiya:- 

 
 
• ​Ravi Kumar Dahiya is an Indian freestyle wrestler who won a silver medal in the men's 57 kg freestyle wrestling at the 2020 Summer Olympics.
 
• He is the** first Indian wrestler to win a medal at the Olympic Games in over two decades.**
 
• Ravi Kumar Dahiya has been awarded the "Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021" for Wrestling. (Hence option 4 is correct)
 
• Dahiya is also a** two-time Asian champion and a Commonwealth Games gold medalist.**
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the best wrestlers in the world in his weight category.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sumit Antil****​**

 
 
• Sumit Antil is an Indian Paralympian and javelin thrower.
 
• He won a gold medal in the men's javelin throw F64 category at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. 
 
• He holds the current world record, having thrown 68.55 meters in the Paralympic final.
 
• Sumit Antil was born on 6 July 1998 in Khewda, Sonipat, Haryana, India.
 
• He lost his left leg below the knee after he was involved in a motorbike accident in 2015 at the age of 17.
 
 
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain**
 
 
• Lovlina Borgohain is an Indian boxer who plays in the 69Kg category. 
 
• She is 23 years old and hails from the Golaghat district of Assam. 
 
• She won a bronze medal in the women's welterweight category at Tokyo Olympics 2021. 
 
• With this win, she became the third boxer to win a medal at the Olympics for India after Vijender Singh and MC Mary Kom's bronze at the 2008 and 2012 Olympics respectively.
 
 
 
• **Krishna Nagar****​**
 
 
• Krishna Nagar **won the gold medal in badminton at the Tokyo Paralympics 2020.**
 
• This **achievement marked a significant moment in India's performance at the Paralympic Games.**
 
• **Krishna Nagar competed in the Men's Singles SH6 category**.
 
• His victory added to India's growing success in para-badminton on the international stage.
 
 

b8:T
